---
title: "Website Directory"
listing:
  id: all-se-articles
  contents:        # show README and all standard elements in the listing
    - "README.qmd"
    - "SE*.qmd"
    - "!index.qmd" # do not list itself
  type: grid
  sort: "title asc"
  categories: true
  sort-ui: [title, date]
  filter-ui: true
  fields: [image, date, title, subtitle, description, reading-time]
---
<!--
Key Options Explained:
contents: The *.qmd tells Quarto to look for all Quarto markdown files in the current directory. !index.qmd specifically excludes this title page so it doesn't list itself. If your pages are inside a specific folder (like docs/ or pages/), you can change this to contents: "pages/*.qmd".

type: grid displays the pages as a visual grid of cards. You can change this to default (a standard blog-style list) or table (a compact data table).

sort: Alphabetizes the pages by their title. You can also sort by date desc if your pages have dates in their individual YAML headers.

categories, sort-ui, filter-ui: These enable interactive elements on your rendered page. They add a sidebar with clickable categories and search/sort bars at the top, making it easy to navigate a large number of pages.

fields: Dictates which metadata from the other pages will show up on the cards. If a page doesn't have an image or a date, Quarto will simply leave that field blank.
-->

Welcome to the site! Below you will find a directory of all available pages.
